TrimTake — Installation Guide
==============================

Step 1: Install the Backend
  - Open TrimTake-backend.dmg
  - Drag "TrimTake Backend" to the Applications folder
  - Open TrimTake Backend from Applications
  - You'll see a notification when the server is running

Step 2: Install the Premiere Pro Extension
  - Download ZXPInstaller from https://zxpinstaller.com (free)
  - Open ZXPInstaller
  - Drag TrimTake-panel.zxp onto the ZXPInstaller window
  - Wait for "Installation complete"

Step 3: Open in Premiere Pro
  - Launch (or restart) Adobe Premiere Pro
  - Go to Window > Extensions > TrimTake
  - The panel will appear and connect to the backend

Step 4: Configure
  - Click the Settings icon in the TrimTake panel
  - Enter your Anthropic API key (get one at https://console.anthropic.com)
  - Adjust sensitivity and padding to your preference
  - Start editing!

Troubleshooting
---------------
- "Backend not connected" — Make sure TrimTake Backend is running
  (check Applications or look for it in Activity Monitor)
- Panel not showing — Restart Premiere Pro after installing the ZXP
- Need Node.js — If not using the .app, install Node.js 18+ from https://nodejs.org
